items.title: Listen
items.text: An hour on the phone about your customers: what they ask, what they need to find, what makes them call.

items.title: Plan
items.text: A page list and a sketch of each page, agreed before anything is built, so there are no surprises.

items.title: Build
items.text: Pages built from tested parts, on a preview address you can click through at any time.

items.title: Launch
items.text: The new site goes live on your domain, with the old addresses redirected so no link breaks.

items.title: Grow
items.text: Monthly checks on speed and search, and small changes whenever you ask.

items.title: Riverside
items.text: By the footbridge. Opens at 7, with the best seats in town for watching rowers.

items.title: Market Hall
items.text: A counter inside the covered market; the roastery is behind it.

items.title: Station
items.text: Coffee to go from 6 am, and the only pastries on the platform.

items.title: Hilltop
items.text: Weekends only, at the end of the trail, with a view worth the climb.
